source_followup.ie.2005.0.8: The statement quantifies over arbitrary integers with odd y,z,w, allowing undefined powers. For example x=0,y=-1,z=w=1 makes x^y undefined. Check whether positive integer exponents were intended.
source_followup.ca.1969.0.1: Nonzero weights do not guarantee a nonzero denominator. Taking a_i=b_i=1 and (p_1,p_2,p_3)=(1,-1,0) satisfies the stated assumptions but gives 0/0. Check the missing denominator restriction.
source_followup.br.1979.0.5: Part (c) changes from a triangle and its centroid to all convex quadrilaterals without defining the corresponding point or area relation. Check the complete original wording.
source_followup.br.1982.0.4: The sliding-tile problem does not specify the shape of the tray or the initial arrangement, and has no linked diagram. Obtain the original layout before deciding the intended reachability statement.
source_followup.br.1984.0.6: The solitaire problem refers to a central square and a square marked X, but neither board layout nor a figure URL is stored. Obtain the original diagram.
source_followup.br.1991.0.3: The first two recurrence terms are not specified or quantified. The identically zero sequence is polynomial for every k and makes the requested term ratio undefined. Check intended initial conditions and existence quantifiers.
source_followup.br.2002.1.3: The grid dimensions need a restriction or exceptional cases. A 1 by 4 board labelled consecutively satisfies the hypothesis but labels k and k+3 are never adjacent. Check whether both dimensions were intended to be at least two.
source_followup.br.2005.2.5: The statement allows a 120-degree angle but defines the Fermat point as an interior point with three 120-degree angles. At that boundary the Fermat point is the vertex and some subtriangles degenerate. Check the strict angle condition and any Euler-line degeneracy exceptions.
source_followup.br.2016.1.3: The displayed count fails for N=k=1: 0 is losing and 1 is winning, so there is one losing integer below 2, while the formula gives two. Check the exponent or the definition of losing states against the official source.
source_followup.mx.1988.1.3: Two common external tangent lines alone do not form a triangle. Check whether the common tangent at the circles contact point is the intended third side.
